assertion_audit.fails_if: Inline execution exceeds five seconds, the request or pointer phase is absent, work runs before handoff, service skips execution, or the receipt drops the supplied commit; restoring inline _execute is observed to fail line 121 at 30.004 s.
The default sweep executes promotion inline, omits its handoff report/request, or the service does not run the queued review promotion.
Landing executes inline, prematurely reports landed, fails to persist a request, or service draining fails to finish its injected promotion.
Width-two scheduling omits either run, serializes two thirty-second delays beyond fifty seconds, or loses a supplied commit.
RuntimeError is swallowed, receipt error/phase is lost, either obligations projection omits or duplicates the failure, or failures leak across sessions.

RUNNING requests are ignored, successful request retirement fails, or a second service re-executes a finished request; the planted request has no actual promotion side effects and its live pointer remains, so the reported crash window stays green.

A second pending request replaces original options/id, another service starts work while an owner holds it, work never starts, or the same run executes twice; event assertions also bound fixture synchronization.

A matching promoted terminal receipt is ignored and execute is called, pending retirement fails, or reading the planted commit is lost; this tests a crash after service receipt, not before that receipt.
The existing admission loop no longer ticks the promotion service or service execution does not publish success.
Explicit refusal is recorded as success, its reason is discarded, automatic retries occur, terminal duplicate suppression fails, or explicit retry is rejected.
Extraction from nested landing receipts or a ledger receipt path stops preserving the supplied commits; both values originate in this test, so this is propagation coverage.
Pending landing processing inspects the promoted row while an asynchronous request owns the run or stops reporting its pending status.
--wait queues instead of executing synchronously, fails to invoke the existing promotion callback once, omits the fake receipt, or leaves a request file.

evidence_caveats: No suite rerun: recorded gate logs were read, as required by the bounded review brief.
The live head helper exited 1 after its required assertions; live-head-validation.log independently matches the saved output against the durable receipt and exits 0.
The negative control ran at the implementation-equivalent parent 1ff2fb47fe2cbf8df85f15329d2f300c461043e0; only evidence HTML changed afterward.
The importer comparison retains 40 baseline failures and reports no added or removed IDs; the required added_failure_count above derives from the armed baseline_suite/after_suite logs.

findings.text: blocking: A restart after accept_clean_review or promote_review_run_itself has completed promotion and removed its live pointer, but before _run writes promotion.json, reloads the still-RUNNING request and unconditionally calls runs.read_pointer; that raises CrewError and _run stores promotion-refused even though the ledger already records success, so the required crash recovery loses the successful outcome; reconcile the durable promoted row or reconstruct the promotion before requiring a live pointer, and cover this exact crash window for both request kinds.

non-blocking: The commit assertions at lines 132,219,238,359,431 and 484 compare against repository.sha also supplied to the fake promotion result or planted receipt; they test propagation but cannot independently establish that the service reports the actual promoted commit, so count them only as propagation coverage and retain the separate real live-receipt validation for commit identity.
